subject: General
notes: kb/Work PB692. "The DYNAMIC and RANDOM phrases shall not be specified for a sequential file" is a FILE CONTROL ENTRY rule, so it is enforced on the entry, in DataBinder.BindFileControl beside the clauses it relates, and not on any verb: it constrains the entry whether or not the file is ever read, written or started. Before this it had no enforcement anywhere (grep for the section number returned only generated-parser noise) and `SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM.` compiled and ran clean. BOTH PHRASES are screened, not just the one the repro wrote (negatives pb692-access-random-organization-sequential and pb692-access-dynamic-organization-sequential are the same entry with RANDOM and with DYNAMIC). ALL THREE SEQUENTIAL SPELLINGS are under it: an explicit ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL, LINE SEQUENTIAL (12.4.5.10.3 GR2 puts the phrase in the ORGANIZATION clause, that clause is written only in the Format 3 entry, and 12.4.5.2 SR11 says "Format 3 shall be specified only for a sequential file or a report file"), and the OMITTED clause, which 12.4.5.10.3 GR6 makes "sequential organization with the RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrase" - the omitted case is the shape a screen keyed on a written clause would miss, and negative pb692-access-dynamic-organization-omitted pins it. The predicate is FileModel.IsSequential, the one spelling of sequential organization, shared with the 12.4.5.9 SR2 screen beside it. Edition-invariant: no docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row touches 12.4.5.5, ANSI X3.23-1985's sequential I-O file control entry likewise offered no ACCESS MODE but SEQUENTIAL, and each 4-edition negative asserts COBOL1858 at 85/2002/2014/2023 (the LINE SEQUENTIAL negative names 2023 ALONE because ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL is a COBOL-2023 introduction - at 85, 2002 and 2014 that source is rejected by kb/Work PB688's organization gate, COBOL0900, and this rule never gets to speak; the positive witness is a 2023 program for the same reason). The COMPLEMENT was measured, not assumed: a static scan of all 1483 SELECT entries under tests/ found the four cells this screen rejects EMPTY and every legal cell populated except LINE SEQUENTIAL with an explicit ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, which had zero witnesses - conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/pb692_line_sequential_access_sequential is that missing positive. Harm closed: without the entry rule, `IsSequential && AccessMode != Sequential` was reachable and 14.9.30.3 SR8/SR9 imply no NEXT under RANDOM, so 14.9.30.4 GR19 made the READ a format 2 random read on a connector that has no keys.
